initialBuild.title: Shaman Early-Mid Game (Noob Friendly)
initialBuild.description:
# Shaman Level Priority Build

This build is for noobs like myself who just want a reference sheet on what to level next. I found this to be super handy and wanted to make one for others. Feedback is always welcome.

**Note**: Max Levels above 100 are later in the game, so if you are confused, just ignore and move on for now 😁

**Icon/Emoji Key:**

🎥: YouTube

🏆: Max Level

### YouTube:🎥 [UnknownnHD](https://www.youtube.com/@UnknownnHD)

- My YouTube channel has nothing to do with this game and is centered around tactical shooter and FPS games as a whole, but I appreciate the support regardless ❤️

# Tab 1 Savvy Basics:

1. [[talent:6]]🏆(Max Lvl)
2. [[talent:5]] 🏆
3. [[talent:448]] Lvl 50

- Only 50, as it falls off at higher levels

1. [[talent:446]]🏆
2. [[talent:1]]🏆
3. [[talent:11]]🏆
4. [[talent:12]]🏆

## After Tab 3:

- [[talent:12]] 100 > 234
- [[talent:448]] 50 > 100

# Tab 2 Mage:

1. [[talent:450]]Lvl 1
2. [[talent:451]]Lvl 1

- For 1-2 above, we are unlocking the attacks to add to our hotbar early.

1. [[talent:457]]🏆(Max Lvl)
2. [[talent:455]] 🏆 & [[talent:452]] 🏆: Max Lvl Together

- Level both at the same time. 
  - ie. [[talent:455]] = 1 Point > [[talent:452]] = 1 Point. Back and forth until both are max.

1. [[talent:451]]Lvl 50
2. [[talent:450]]Lvl 10
3. [[talent:456]]🏆
4. [[talent:459]]🏆
5. [[talent:463]] Lvl 50

- Only 50, as it falls off at higher levels

### OPTIONAL:

- [[talent:454]] OR [[talent:450]] 
  - Both are good if you are actively playing.

# Tab 3 Mage: Shaman

1. [[talent:480]] Lvl 1
2. [[talent:481]] Lvl 1
3. [[talent:482]] Lvl 1

- For 1-3 above, we are unlocking the attacks to add to our hotbar early.

1. [[talent:485]]🏆(Max Lvl)
2. [[talent:488]]🏆

- Allows for more points to be put into [[talent:12]] on \\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*Tab 1\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*

1. [[talent:494]] : 🏆

- Allows you to put more damage points into Tab 2.

1. Max out [[talent:480]] > [[talent:481]] > [[talent:482]]
